title: Receipt Before Action
summary: Creates the auditable decision record before commitment rather than after the outcome is known.
mechanism: The receipt binds the action, affected parties, evidence, classification, threshold, safeguards, Maybe/Therefore, owner, review date, and effectiveness check. No record means no authorization.
failure_modes: Receipt that cannot be linked to the executed act
test_status: Receipt generation and static workbench contracts are implemented; real-world audit and outcome value remain open.
next_tests: Test tamper evidence and version migration
Measure audit usefulness and correction speed
